description: In a static `<md>`, a second spelling of an IN construct (`__x__`, `_x_`, `* item`) renders as literal text and is reported with its W-MD lint (a Warning).
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S462 Q22 "c is good" (static `<md>` is strict: a second spelling is text plus its lint) · ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S462 `<md>` F3 "a works. one way to do it with lints to guide"
rationale: §67.3 (Q22): static `<md>` is strict — a second spelling renders as text plus a `W-MD-*` lint naming the canonical form. W-MD codes are Warnings (§67.11).

expect.dom:
This is __not strong__ and _not em_.

* not a list item
